title: 第24章 夜晚的洪江流域第25章 当年的无辜冤魂尘归尘土归土
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
五十海里的距离，对于依靠风帆或人力的船只来说或许需要不短的时间，但对于这艘烧煤的蒸汽巨轮而言，说远也不算太远。
四个小时左右的航程，足够它从红树湾码头抵达那片神秘的江心水域。
折腾了半晌，蒸汽轮机终于发出低沉的轰鸣，粗大的烟囱喷吐着滚滚浓烟，推动着庞大的船体破开浑浊的江水逆流而上。
航行途中，江面上的船只渐渐稀少。
许多跑短途的货船、渔船开始纷纷回港，或者转向通往内陆其他城市的支流。
而一些悬挂着不同旗帜、准备远航的大船，则顺着这条被称为“洪江”
、贯穿大夏半壁江山、最终注入大洋的主航道，前往南洋乃至西洋诸国进行贸易。
接近傍晚时分，蒸汽货轮缓缓驶入了江心一片相对开阔、水流明显更加湍急、水色也似乎更深沉的水域。
颜临同走到船头，对照着航标和记忆中的地形，低声对陆云道：“师傅，前面不远，差不多再有一海里，就是“鬼哭坳”
的核心区域了。”
甲板上，陆云静静的伫立在船头，手中拄着拐杖，江风猎猎，吹动着他银白的发。
颜临同则是侍立在一旁，大气不敢出，只是警惕的观察着四周。
陆云收回目光，直接对颜临同吩咐道：“时间差不多了，让船上的所有伙计，包括船长、舵手、司炉工，全部进舱。”
“没有我的吩咐，谁也不准出来，更不准靠近舷窗张望。”
他不知道接下来会遇到什么，是否会重现陆景腾那晚的诡异遭遇。
为了安全起见，最好的办法就是让他们全部回避。
“是，师傅！”
，颜临同毫不迟疑，立刻转身去传达命令。
很快，船上除了蒸汽机持续的轰鸣，再无人声。
所有船员都被严令进入舱室，紧闭门窗，偌大的甲板上只剩下陆云一人独立站在船头上。

夕阳正以肉眼可见的速度沉入远山，时间也在无声无息中流逝。
直到夕阳彻底沉没，夜幕渐渐笼罩了整个江面与天空。
星辰稀疏，月色朦胧，唯有船上挂着的几盏从西洋舶来的、带有玻璃罩的煤油壁灯。
它散发着昏黄而摇曳的光晕，勉强照亮了甲板中央一小片区域。
夜风带着刺骨的凉意，一阵阵吹拂而过，吹得壁灯的火苗不安的晃动。
陆云端坐在特意搬来的一张藤椅上，神色平静无波。
他双指间夹着香烟，时不时吸上一口，缓缓吐出淡青色的烟雾。
脚下的蒸汽货轮早就熄灭了锅炉，巨大的船身依靠沉重的铁锚固定在江中，静静停泊在距离“鬼哭坳”
核心区域约一海里的地方。
陆云并不着急，他偶尔会拿起旁边小桌上放着的一具黄铜制成的西洋单筒望远镜，仔细观察一海里外那片被黑暗完全吞噬的江心水域。
望远镜的视野里，除了被放大后显得更加深邃幽暗的江水便再无他物。
那片水域寂静得仿佛只是一片再普通不过的深夜江面，与传说中的“鬼哭坳”
名号毫不相称。
一直等到了子夜时分，江风愈凉，万籁俱寂。
望远镜中依旧是一片令人失望的漆黑与平静，毫无动静。
陆云缓缓放下望远镜，心中掠过一丝淡淡的失望。
他本以为亲自来到此地，或许能发现些什么，毕竟自己大儿子陆景腾是在这里中的招。
content_en:
The distance of fifty nautical miles may take a long time for a ship that relies on sails or manpower, but for this coal-burning steam ship, it is not too far.
The voyage of about four hours is enough for it to reach the mysterious waters in the middle of the river from the Mangrove Bay Pier.
After struggling for a long time, the steam turbine finally made a low roar, and the thick chimney spit out billowing smoke, pushing the huge hull to break through the turbid river water and go upstream.
During the voyage, the number of ships on the river gradually became scarce.
Many short-distance cargo ships and fishing boats began to return to the port, or turned to tributaries leading to other inland cities.
Some large ships flying different flags and preparing for long voyages followed this river called "Hongjiang"
, the main waterway that runs through half of Daxia and finally flows into the ocean, going to Southeast Asia and even Western countries for trade.
Towards evening, the steam freighter slowly sailed into a relatively open area of ​​water in the middle of the river, where the water flow was obviously more turbulent and the color of the water seemed to be deeper.
Yan Lintong walked to the bow of the ship, compared the navigation mark with the terrain in his memory, and whispered to Lu Yun: "Master, not far ahead, about a mile away, is the "Ghost Crying Ao"
core area. "
On the deck, Lu Yun stood quietly at the bow of the ship, holding a cane in his hand, and the river wind blew his silver hair.
Yan Lintong stood aside, not daring to express his anger, but just observing the surroundings vigilantly.
Lu Yun withdrew his gaze and directly told Yan Lintong: "It's almost time. Let all the crew members on the ship, including the captain, helmsman, and stoker, enter the cabin."
"No one is allowed to come out without my instructions, let alone look through the portholes."
He didn't know what he would encounter next, whether Lu Jingteng's strange experience that night would happen again.
To be on the safe side, the best thing to do is to avoid them all.
"Yes, master!"
, Yan Lintong did not hesitate and immediately turned around to convey the order.
Soon, there was no sound on the ship except the continuous roar of the steam engine.
All crew members were strictly ordered to enter the cabin and close the doors and windows. Only Lu Yun was left standing alone on the bow of the huge deck.
The setting sun is sinking into the distant mountains at a speed visible to the naked eye, and time is passing by silently.
Until the sunset completely sank, night gradually enveloped the entire river and sky.
The stars were sparse and the moon was hazy. There were only a few kerosene wall lamps with glass shades imported from the West hanging on the ship.
It exuded a dim and flickering light, barely illuminating a small area in the center of the deck.
The night wind blew by with a biting chill, causing the flames of the wall lamps to sway uneasily.
Lu Yun was sitting on a specially brought wicker chair with a calm expression.
He held the cigarette between his fingers, taking a puff from time to time and slowly exhaling light blue smoke.
The steam freighter underfoot has long extinguished its boiler. The huge hull is fixed in the river with heavy anchors, and it is parked quietly at a distance from "Ghost Crying Ao".
The core area is about one nautical mile away.
Lu Yun was not in a hurry. He would occasionally pick up a brass Western monocular telescope placed on the small table next to him and carefully observe the waters in the center of the river one sea mile away that were completely swallowed up by darkness.
In the field of view of the telescope, there is nothing but the magnified river, which appears deeper and darker.
The water area was so quiet that it seemed like it was just an ordinary late-night river surface, with the legendary "Ghost Crying Ao"
The name is totally inappropriate.
Until midnight, the river wind became colder and colder, and everything was silent.
The telescope was still disappointingly dark and calm, with no movement.
Lu Yun slowly put down the telescope, a hint of disappointment passing through his heart.
He thought he might be able to find something by coming here in person. After all, his eldest son Lu Jingteng was tricked here.
